g.title: Long shot. A street at night, in the rain. Alice, left, pointing, looking at Bob; Bob, right, arms crossed. Caption: Midnight. The corner of Fifth. Alice: You forgot your umbrella!
Medium close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Bob, centre, arms crossed. Bob, whispering: I know.
Full shot. A street at night, in the rain. Alice, left, pointing, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, arms crossed. Alice: You know? Then why did you leave it? Bob: So you would come after me.
Close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Alice, centre, surprised. Alice: Oh.
Close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Bob, centre, happy. Bob, whispering: Shall we?
